messages:
Ravi M.: follow-up: can we do per-response precision handoff (FP8 -> INT8 -> 4bit) but keep cache and replay sane?

Tess L.: short answer: yes with constraints. we should only switch at block boundaries to avoid partial-kv mismatches.

Jordan F.: agree. also need a deterministic contract: runtime must record switch token indices in response metadata.

Ravi M.: what about KV storage? naive approach duplicates memory.

Tess L.: canonicalize to FP16 and lazy-cast to lower precision on switch. saves memory, small cast cost.

Jordan F.: measured cast cost ~0.4ms/layer on our test GPU. acceptable if we batch casts and limit switches.

Ravi M.: telemetry + rollback?

Tess L.: emit events: switch_points, pre/post entropy, latency_delta. rollback: endpoint flag to disable seams.

build-bot: Note: please open canary request with eng-sre before test rollout.

Ravi M.: action items: Tess + Jordan run 32/64 block experiment and report perf+quality next week. I'll draft the runtime contract. Thanks!
